changes.title: Definitions
changes.oldText: "effective date" means the date on which this Agreement is signed by both parties.

changes.title: Limitation of liability
changes.oldText: Each party's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

changes.oldText: This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives thirty (30) days' written notice.
